## Scaffolding a React + TypeScript Project with Vite

### 1. Create the Project

```bash
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts
```

> **Alternative package managers:**
> ```bash
> # Yarn
> yarn create vite my-app --template react-ts
>
> # pnpm
> pnpm create vite my-app --template react-ts
>
> # Bun
> bun create vite my-app --template react-ts
> ```

---

### 2. Navigate into the Project Directory

```bash
cd my-app
```

---

### 3. Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

---

### 4. Start the Dev Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

---

### Expected Output

```
  VITE v5.x.x  ready in 300 ms

  ➜  Local:   http://localhost:5173/
  ➜  Network: use --host to expose
  ➜  press h + enter to show help
```

---

### Full One-Liner (copy & paste ready)

```bash
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts && cd my-app && npm install && npm run dev
```

---

### Project Structure Generated

```
my-app/
├── public/
├── src/
│   ├── assets/
│   ├── App.tsx        # Root component
│   ├── App.css
│   ├── main.tsx       # Entry point
│   └── vite-env.d.ts  # Vite type declarations
├── index.html
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── vite.config.ts
```

> The dev server runs on **`http://localhost:5173`** by default with **Hot Module Replacement (HMR)** enabled.

const _ = require('lodash');

});

  expect(_.capitalize('hello world')).toBe('Hello world');
});
EOF

### 5. Run the Test Suite

```bash
# Run all tests
